# TitiLinks

> TitiLinks is a premium link-in-bio platform that makes an everyday creator's single link look like a celebrity's: a styled, hosted profile page that gathers their links, content, products and socials in one place. Bilingual (English / Spanish), built for Latin creators, athletes, artists, musicians, small businesses and side-hustlers.

- Website: https://www.titilinks.com
- Creator pages live at https://www.titilinks.com/<handle>
- Templates: https://www.titilinks.com/templates
- Made by Joey Colley (https://joeyc.ai), Nampa, Idaho

## What it does

- One shareable link for a bio (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube) that holds everything a creator is.
- Cinematic, designer-quality page themes; "you don't have to be famous to look it".
- Blocks for links, featured media, product cards, YouTube feeds, events and socials.
- Short links, QR codes, analytics, and AI-assisted setup and link suggestions.
- Pricing: Free forever, or Pro from $7/month billed annually ($9 month-to-month) at a locked founding price; the list price is $15/month.

## Policies

- Privacy: https://www.titilinks.com/privacy
